source: Cursor through @cursor/sdk 1.0.31 in Mako's SDK child, recorded 2026-10-17 from two real children on one agent
about: A new agent's three sequential reads, then the same agent resumed by a second child and asked one thing. Each checkpoint's context reading (token_details: the last model call's input and output, of the model's window) reaches the host as a context event: four in the first turn, which sum to exactly that turn's usage inputTokens + outputTokens (48206), one as the resumed agent opens from its latest root, with no turn, and one after the second turn's only call (12185 + 18 = 12203).
